new_quote.description: Verbatim quote copied character-for-character from exactly one change-order line. Write this first.

new_segment_id.description: The pNNNN id of the change-order line the new quote comes from.

old_doc.description: The agreement_id of the earlier chain document holding the old term, "self" if the change order itself restates the old term, or null if the target document is not provided.

old_quote.description: Verbatim quote of the old term copied from one line of old_doc, or null.

old_segment_id.description: The pNNNN id of the line the old quote comes from, or null.

old_value.description: For shifted_date: the old date as YYYY-MM-DD, written in old_quote. Otherwise null.

new_value.description: For shifted_date: the new date as YYYY-MM-DD. For price_change: the new amount exactly as written in new_quote. Otherwise null.

target_label.description: The target reference copied from new_quote, e.g. Section 2.C of 2A, or null.

context_quote.description: For price_change: a verbatim quote from one change-order line giving the row period or heading, or null.

context_segment_id.description: The pNNNN id of the context quote line, or null.
